cases.title: Off by default: a run without humanReview applies as today
steps: Start a run with the fake provider and --web as TESTING.md describes, without --human-review and with no humanReview in the config
Poll GET /state until summary is set
cases.expected: The run never pauses (no review banner, state.review absent); summary.exitCode is 0 and the starting branch has the result as uncommitted changes

cases.title: Pause, then Apply
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review
Poll GET /state until review.waiting is true
GET /review
POST /review/apply with body {} and the Origin header of the server
cases.expected: GET /review returns 200 with round 1; apply returns 200; the run ends with exit code 0 and the result is on the starting branch as uncommitted changes

cases.title: Request changes sends comments to the fixer and pauses again
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review
Wait for review.waiting
POST /review/comments with {"body":"rename the output file"}
POST /review/changes
Watch GET /state and the run's logs
cases.expected: A fix pass runs labeled 'fix pass 1/3 (human round 1)', the fixer prompt in the logs contains '## Human review comments' and human-H1-1, and the run pauses again with review round 2

cases.title: Restart while waiting keeps the pause and the drafts
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review (no --web, so it runs in the foreground)
Wait for 'waiting for your review:' and POST /review/comments with a body
Send SIGINT to the run
Run graph-execution --resume
GET /review on the new URL
cases.expected: The interrupted run exits with code 2; after --resume the run waits for review again and GET /review lists the draft comment

cases.title: Drop keeps the result branch and applies nothing
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review
Wait for review.waiting
POST /review/drop
cases.expected: The run ends; git status on the starting branch shows no changes from the run; branch graph/<run-id> still exists

cases.title: Apply with open findings needs force
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review, with a fake script where reviewer:code-r* always reports a blocker and fixPasses is 0 in the config
Wait for review.waiting
POST /review/apply with {}
POST /review/apply with {"force":true}
cases.expected: The first apply returns 409; the second returns 200 and the summary says 'applied with 1 open finding(s)'

cases.title: Each comment shows its outcome; resolve and reopen work
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review
Add a comment, POST /review/changes, wait for review round 2
GET /review
POST /review/comments/H1-1/reopen with {"followUp":"also the README"}
POST /review/comments/H1-1/resolve
cases.expected: GET /review includes outcomes for H1-1 (fixer note or 'no note', and a reviewer verdict with evidence); reopen returns 200 with status reopened and the follow-up; resolve returns 200 with status resolved

cases.title: Line comment from the browser
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes (web view section), adding --human-review
Open the URL in a browser (agent-browser) and wait for the review banner
Expand a file in the review diff and click a new-side line number
Type a comment and save
cases.expected: The comment appears under that line with its id H1-1, and GET /review lists it with file, line and a non-empty snippet

cases.title: Human review without --web prints the URL
steps: Start a run with the fake provider as TESTING.md describes, with --human-review and without --web
cases.expected: The terminal prints 'web view: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/' and, at the pause, 'waiting for your review: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/'; GET /state on that URL answers
